scope: settlement integrity; goals, BTTS, provider-yellow-card research; corners protected
data: all locally available provider-native raw match/stats cache; no paid calls or downloads
chronology: coverage-only timestamp-group 60/20/20 split; 28h purge; expanding second fold when supported
calibration: two regularized multiplicative side corrections fitted before test; preserve joint coherence
optional_features: xG separate coverage-qualified arm; no npxG; no unverified event/lineup/referee/weather proxies
strength: lagged competition-local Elo feature, fixed K20 scale400 home50; deterministic candidate not ground truth
support: mandatory core own-production and opponent-concession history; optional missingness explicit; no all-missing column accepted
confirmation: all available outcomes previously accessible; DEVELOPMENT_ONLY; no automatic promotion
promotion: requires untouched chronological predictive gain, calibration noninferiority and market-adjusted gate; unavailable odds -> MARKET_UNTESTED
search_budget: fixed alpha and bundles; no tuning after results; NB dispersion fitted train only; DC rho fitted train only
uncertainty: paired week-block bootstrap with fixture rows grouped; nominal development intervals only
